# Hungary after victory: the German civil war.

# HUN scope: join Italy's Pact of Rome, and never be taken back by a reunified Reich.
wif_hunv_to_rome = {
	set_country_flag = wif_cw_never_returns
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ITA ITA = { is_faction_leader = yes } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ITA } }
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		ITA = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}

# HUN scope: back into the reunified Reich's faction.
wif_hunv_rejoin_reich = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER GER = { is_faction_leader = yes } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = GER } }
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		GER = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = DWM DWM = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 0.9 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_dwm }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = BOR BOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 0.9 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_bor }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = SPG SPG = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 0.95 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_spg }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = GOR GOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 0.95 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_gor }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = DWM DWM = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 0.95 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_dwm }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = BOR BOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 0.95 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_bor }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = SPG SPG = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.0 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_spg }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = GOR GOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.0 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_gor }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = DWM DWM = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.0 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_dwm }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = BOR BOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.0 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_bor }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = SPG SPG = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.01 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_spg }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = GOR GOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.01 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_gor }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = DWM DWM = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.01 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_dwm }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found } country_exists = BOR BOR = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent surrender_progress < 1.01 } } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found set_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_bor }
		clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_found
		wif_hunv_go_to_war = yes
	}
}

# HUN scope: a side has been picked (flag wif_hunv_pick_<tag>) - war on its enemies, limited.
wif_hunv_go_to_war = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_spg country_exists = SPG } SPG = { save_event_target_as = wif_hunv_side set_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_spg set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_picked clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_spg }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_gor country_exists = GOR } GOR = { save_event_target_as = wif_hunv_side set_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_gor set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_picked clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_gor }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_dwm country_exists = DWM } DWM = { save_event_target_as = wif_hunv_side set_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_dwm set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_picked clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_dwm }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_bor country_exists = BOR } BOR = { save_event_target_as = wif_hunv_side set_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side } set_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_bor set_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_picked clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_pick_bor }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_picked }
		# Everyone already fighting stays in; anyone who joins later is sent home (wif_hunv_daily).
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent }
			set_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_war_with = ROOT any_enemy_country = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent } } }
			set_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar
		set_global_flag = wif_hunv_limited_war
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_ger_cw_belligerent
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side }
				has_war_with = event_target:wif_hunv_side
			}
			ROOT = { declare_war_on = { target = PREV type = annex_everything } }
		}
		add_ideas = wif_hunv_limited_war_idea
		news_event = { id = wif_hunv.21 days = 1 }
	}
}

# HUN scope, daily during the limited war: nobody else may join on either side.
wif_hunv_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_hunv_limited_war }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_war_with = ROOT NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar } }
			white_peace = { tag = ROOT }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side }
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_war_with = PREV NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar } }
				white_peace = { tag = PREV }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_ger_civil_war_won }
			clr_global_flag = wif_hunv_limited_war
			if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_hunv_limited_war_idea } remove_ideas = wif_hunv_limited_war_idea }
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar } clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_lw_prewar }
			every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side } clr_country_flag = wif_hunv_is_our_side }
		}
	}
}

# HUN scope: The Reich Returns - did we back the winner?
wif_hunv_reich_remembers = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_hunv_won = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_spg has_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_spg } set_temp_variable = { wif_hunv_won = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_gor has_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_gor } set_temp_variable = { wif_hunv_won = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_dwm has_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_dwm } set_temp_variable = { wif_hunv_won = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_bor has_country_flag = wif_hunv_backed_bor } set_temp_variable = { wif_hunv_won = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER check_variable = { wif_hunv_won > 0 } }
		GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = wif_hunv_op_p50 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER has_country_flag = wif_hunv_side_picked }
		GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = wif_hunv_op_m50 } }
	}
}

# HUN scope, weekly: the focuses that complete themselves.
wif_hunv_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = wif_hunv_stand_with_the_axis
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_hunv_stand_by_the_winner }
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_hunv_choose_a_side }
			has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_ssr }
		}
		complete_national_focus = wif_hunv_stand_by_the_winner
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = wif_hunv_stand_with_the_axis
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_hunv_dark_dawn }
			has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified
			has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_ssr
		}
		complete_national_focus = wif_hunv_dark_dawn
	}
	# The Axis-loyal Hungary goes back into the reunified Reich's faction.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_hunv_axis_loyal
			has_global_flag = wif_ger_reunified
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_cw_winner_ssr }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cw_never_returns }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_hunv_rejoined }
			has_war = no
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_hunv_rejoined
		wif_hunv_rejoin_reich = yes
	}
}

# HUN scope: Victorious in a New World - the tree is wiped and the post-war tree loaded.
wif_hunv_load_victory_tree = {
	set_country_flag = wif_hunv_victorious
	load_focus_tree = { tree = wif_hun_victory_focus keep_completed = no }
	complete_national_focus = wif_hunv_victorious
	news_event = { id = wif_hunv.1 hours = 6 }
}
